mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days because elevated interest rates compress equity valuations and increase the cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return over all trading days (with FEDFUNDS data available) is positive, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) signals persistent economic strength that may lead to aggressive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) indicates a monetary policy tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 320, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signal robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 AND HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 155000) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 155000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of strong residential sales (RSAFS > 700000) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1200) indicates a robust housing market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS > 700000 AND HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 days because rising interest rates increase the cost of capital and reduce corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
